import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import PageBanner from '../components/PageBanner'; const About = () => ( <>

Our Story

Crafted with love. Designed to last.

The House of B.unique

Handmade Jewellery, Made with Soul

B.unique is a celebration of handcrafted elegance. Every piece in our collection is thoughtfully designed and meticulously crafted by skilled artisans, bringing together timeless traditions and contemporary aesthetics.

We believe jewellery should be more than an accessory — it should tell a story. From delicate everyday pieces to statement designs for life's grandest moments, our creations are made to be treasured for generations.

Each piece carries the touch of the maker — subtle, unique, and unmistakably human. That's the beauty of handmade.

Why Choose Us

Crafted with Purpose

{v.title}
{v.text}
))}

); export default About;
